description: Assemble a campaign URL with consistent UTM tagging, normalise the values so they do not split into duplicate rows in analytics, and report every correction made and every risk found. Also flags a source or medium that departs from the conventional value for the platform, which silently breaks channel grouping.

base_url.description: Landing page URL, with or without an existing query string.

convention.description: Naming convention applied to every value.

platform.description: Optional platform key, used to check source and medium against the conventional values.

name: build_utm
